verdict.rationale: Yapily documents a Payments API for single, scheduled and periodic bank-to-bank payments. It also covers bulk payment authorisation, variable recurring payments, hosted/Connect PIS flows with SCA handling, and webhook status tracking. On geography, it names UK Faster Payments and European SEPA rails. Missing for 10: an explicit list of live countries or bank coverage beyond the rail mentions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of payment initiation working in production.
